title: Week 17: Overleaf
content:
Week 17: Overleaf

Well, I found this editor that supports full Latex support and also can be hosted on a serf-service.

The original idea is to use it so that my supervisor can review my result with it. I tried to host it i=on a 8GB server. It can not fully support all the latex features. While the online service can, although it is not a free version as I have a such long thesis.

Eventually, I wrote my thesis with Latex locally, but the Overleaf editor is still a recommandation.
